_node_count_comment: Threshold values here are from a 4-node (4N) run. Throughput and step-time scale with the GPU count, so if you run a different number of nodes, update these values to the appropriate targets for that node count.
_comment: RECORD-ONLY placeholder thresholds for DeepSeek-V4 284B (deepseek4-284b / DeepSeek-V4-Flash MoE), keyed by sweep name. Every metric is kind='info' (always PASS, no gating) -- no measured baselines yet. After the first clean runs, switch the tflops/tokens entries to 'min' gates and final_loss to a 'max' gate, then set enforce_thresholds=true. The cell key must match the config's sweep key exactly.
